category: hosted authentication, authorization, feature flags and customer billing

free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 forever: 10,500 monthly active users, 5 monthly active organizations, 2 custom roles and 10 permissions, 10 feature flags, 5 custom properties, 1 webhook, 2 environments (production and development), email, SMS and social login, MFA, organizations, a custom domain, M2M applications, subscriptions and billing, attack protection, unlimited dashboard seats and unlimited applications; no credit card required
free_tier.notes: An MAU is a user that authenticates in the month; users on paid subscription plans do not count toward the allowance. When the user bills customers through Kinde, MAU is free and Kinde takes 0.7% per transaction. The paid tiers are Pro at USD 25/month, Plus at USD 75/month and Scale at USD 250/month, each with 10,500 MAU included and per-extra-user charges.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-object size cap is stated on the pages read; an imported OpenAPI file is capped at 20 MB, a limit on a paid-plan feature rather than on the hosted service

retention.stated: Audit logs are kept 1 day on Free, 7 days on Pro, 14 days on Plus and 30 days on Scale; runtime logs for custom pages and workflows are kept 1 hour on Free

egress.terms: not applicable: a hosted authentication API; no traffic allowance or per-GB egress price is published

interface_detail: A Kinde Management API and an Account API, documented with an OpenAPI description. The Management API uses a machine-to-machine application and a Bearer token at https://<subdomain>.kinde.com/api/v1/; API keys are offered on paid plans only. Device-flow authentication supports TVs, IoT devices and command-line applications.
tooling: SDKs for more than 20 languages, the Kinde Management API, the Account API, the Kinde CLI and the dashboard; M2M applications give programmatic access on Free.
chaining: An OIDC identity provider in front of apps on free compute, with email, phone and social login, MFA, organizations and a built-in billing module; user and organization data is reachable through the Management API.

limits.value: 5 monthly active organizations, 2 custom roles, 10 permissions, 10 feature flags and 1 webhook on Free
2,000 M2M tokens and 10 SMS included free on Free
audit logs kept 1 day and runtime logs kept 1 hour on Free
API keys, API scopes and passkeys are not included on Free; these need a paid plan

binding_note: The 10,500-MAU ceiling binds first at scale; Free has no overage rate, and the 5-organization and single-webhook caps bind sooner for a B2B app.

identity_cost.detail: The account creation steps in the first-party docs say to enter a first name, last name and email address, then verify the email with a one-time code; the sign-up page offers Google, GitHub and SSO alternatives. The pricing page states no credit card is required for Free. Business details later ask for a business name, a Kinde domain and a region; a business phone number is optional. Whether any identity document is requested is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Audit data is retained only 1 day on Free, so longer forensics need a paid plan. The monthly prices are stated as indicative and can vary with actual usage.
confidence_note: Quota, retention and tier prices come from the first-party pricing page, signup fields from the first-party getting-started docs, and API access from the first-party API reference. No probe was run and no account was opened; the live sign-up page returned a WAF challenge, so the form fields are taken from the docs.
